scope: The rule of Heth Fal over the Sworn Men of Laehiford, 39-51
passage: Heth Fal held the seat of the Sworn Men of Laehiford from 33, having taken it from the Kebarrow Compact.
corrected: Heth Fal took the seat of the Sworn Men of Laehiford in 39 after an election set aside the claim of the named heir Herpeim Raern.
note: two reigns in two seats: Kebarrow 33-35 and Laehiford 39-51, and they are two scopes
